verdict.rationale: gstack is a set of agent skills for planning, review, QA and shipping, so bulk operations are a fair question for it. The evidence documents no capability for acting on many items at once. The closest features are adjacent: /autoplan runs several review skills one after another as a pipeline, and /qa fixes bugs one atomic commit at a time. Neither is a batch operation across a set of items.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
